description.value:
Effect your second shot at the same target this turn has its multiple attack penalty reduced by 1

Point both pistols at one target instead of splitting your attention between two.

cinderfall.incomplete: reduce second-shot MAP by 1 vs. same target. (this one is close to rhythm-not-aim's REAL shape, but it's phrased as a one-shot action rather than a constant passive and has no level/Requirement to anchor a standing rule element to — flagged in Open Questions as a possible REAL candidate if reframed as a toggle). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
